text: dsh-sandbox-presets-extra 是一款 DSH 插件，可注册自定义权限预设，为选中的会话增加指定目录的写入权限。每个预设选择 read-only、workspace-write 或 danger-full-access 模式及 ask 或 never 审批策略，并可配置绝对路径或按会话工作区解析的 workspace: 路径。插件将规则应用到文件系统检查和 bwrap 命令配置，并把当前额外可写目录告知模型。适合需要按会话配置沙箱目录权限的用户；Linux 受限命令扩展需 bwrap。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra registers DSH permission presets with additional writable directories. Presets choose a sandbox mode and approval policy, and can use paths relative to each session workspace. It extends filesystem checks and bwrap profiles.
想给不同 DSH 会话配置各自额外可写的目录。
能不能给只读权限预设单独开放几个目录写入？
我希望工作区外的指定文件夹也能从 DSH 里编辑。
让 DSH 的权限选择器提供我自己定义的沙箱预设。
Allow a selected preset to grant access to paths relative to each session workspace.
Let me define extra writable directories separately for each DSH permission preset.
dsh-sandbox-presets-extra 的功能「注册权限预设」：读取 presets 配置，为每项指定沙箱模式、审批策略和额外可写目录，并发布到 DSH 权限预设表供会话选择。
dsh-sandbox-presets-extra 的功能「按预设扩展目录写入」：选中预设后，文件系统检查会重新判定授权目录，bwrap 受限命令也会加入对应绑定；workspace: 路径按当前会话工作区解析。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · dsh-sandbox-presets-extra：English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Registers **any number of configured permission presets** in DeepSeek Harness.
Each preset selects a sandbox mode and an approval policy, plus the directories
that become writable on top of whatever that mode already allows.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · dsh-sandbox-presets-extra：That covers both directions the harness can express — a `workspace-write` preset
that opens directories beside the session workspace, and a `read-only` preset
that opens exactly the directories it lists and nothing else — and any number of
each.

The three stock sandbox modes are not modified in any way: `read-only`,
`workspace-write`, and `danger-full-access` keep their exact meaning, their
persisted schemas, and their escalation ladder.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · What it adds：| Preset | Sandbox mode | Approval | Writes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `read-only` | `read-only` | `ask` | nothing |
| `workspace-write` | `workspace-write` | `ask` | workspace + temp areas |
| `workspace-write-extra` | `workspace-write` | `ask` | the above **+ its configured directories** |
| `scratch` | `read-only` | `never` | **only its configured directories** |
| `danger-full-access` | `danger-full-access` | `never` | everything |

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · What it adds：A preset is a *permission preset*, not a fourth `SandboxMode`. That distinction
is the whole point: the sandbox mode vocabulary is a closed three-value union
that is written into `sandbox/mode` session events and re-validated by several
foreign projections when a session is restored. A fourth value there would make
every session that used it unreadable. Bundling an existing mode with extra
behaviour is the same approach the shipped `auto` preset takes.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · What it adds：Enablement is per session: a preset's directories apply while that session's last
recorded permission preset is that preset, which survives a restart because the
choice lives in the session log.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · How it stays out of the way：The plugin does not disable, replace, or reorder any stock row. It wraps the two
live enforcement services **in place**, and unwraps them exactly on unload:

* the mounted filesystem's containment check (`checkedTarget`) gains a retry of
  its denial against the directories the selected preset grants;
* the sandbox provider's `confine` gains the matching `--bind` pairs in the
  bwrap profile.
section: How it stays out of the way

text:
dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · How it stays out of the way：The fence retry deliberately covers `read-only` as well: the stock fence refuses
a read-only mutation before it ever resolves the target, so the wrapper resolves
the target itself and compares it against the preset's directories. That is what
lets a `read-only` preset grant writes, and it grants exactly the directories it
lists.
section: How it stays out of the way

text:
dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · How it stays out of the way：The model-facing note needs the same correction, because the stock
`sandbox:policy` note is rendered from the mode alone: under `read-only` it
states that nothing may be modified, and under `workspace-write` it names only
the workspace, while a selected preset may in fact make further directories
writable. The plugin therefore registers **a runtime context of its own**, right
after the stock note, naming the directories the selected preset grants. In both
confined modes the note reads as a closed boundary, so the sentence states the
exception outright instead of relying on "additionally" alone to be read as an
override of the sentence before it: under `read-only` it says the directories are
writable *even under the read-only policy above* (the stock sentence reads as a
flat prohibition), and under `workspace-write` it says they are writable *whether
or not they are inside the session workspace* (the stock sentence names only that
path and reads as the whole writable area). A `danger-full-access` preset
contributes nothing: that mode already restricts nothing, so "additionally
writable directories" would be a false state
section: How it stays out of the way

text:
dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · How it stays out of the way：The note is a context of its own rather than an amendment of the stock one, and
that distinction is what makes it reach the model. The agent loop re-resolves
every runtime context **from its registered provider** while preparing each
request, then logs the result as the snapshot the next step reads. A copy of
another subsystem's entry that this plugin rewrote in the
`system-prompt/assemble` waterfall is therefore present in a direct `assemble()`
call and absent from every real step — the provider's own text replaces it. A
provider of this plugin's own survives that refresh, and re-rendering from the
live selection is what makes the note follow a preset switch. Registering under
the stock name is not an option either, since the system-prompt service keys
contexts by name within one layer and rejects a duplicate.
section: How it stays out of the way

text:
dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · How it stays out of the way：* **Failure is safe.** If this plugin does not load, the harness keeps the stock
  filesystem and sandbox rather than losing them. (The alternative — disabling
  the stock rows and inserting replacements — has no such fallback, and Cordis
  refuses to register two providers of the same service name, so it cannot be
  made safe by shadowing.)
* **It is additive.** The stock check stays authoritative for every case it
  already handled; only its own denial is reconsidered.
section: How it stays out of the way

text: dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Configuration：Both surfaces are supported.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Profile config：```yaml
- id: sandbox-presets-extra
  name: dsh-sandbox-presets-extra
  config:
    presets:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sandbox` | `workspace-write` | `read-only`, `workspace-write`, or `danger-full-access` |
| `approval` | `ask` | `ask` or `never` |
| `writableDirs` | `[]` | Directories writable on top of the selected mode |
| `name` | the preset key | Optional display label |
| `description` | none | Optional one-line description |

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Profile config：Omit `name` unless you want a specific label: the picker derives its text from
the preset key otherwise (`workspace-write-extra` renders as
`Workspace Write Extra`), while a supplied label is shown verbatim, in English,
because the client localizes only its own built-in presets.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Profile config：Directories must be absolute; a leading `~` is expanded. Symlinks are resolved,
and a missing or non-directory entry is **ignored with a warning** rather than
created — granting a path nobody named would be the unsafe direction. Expansion
is asynchronous, so a directory only becomes writable after its own successful
expansion. A preset whose `sandbox` or `approval` is not one of the values above
is likewise refused with a warning instead of being published, as are the
reserved names `custom` and `auto`.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Profile config：An entry prefixed with `workspace:` names a path **relative to the session
workspace**, and is resolved separately for each session:

```yaml
workspace-write-extra:
  writableDirs:
    - /srv/shared-assets
    - workspace:notes        # <session workspace>/notes

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Profile config：A directory below the workspace is resolved per call, against the root the
harness folds for the calling session, rather than once while the plugin loads:
the workspace belongs to the session, and the plugin does not know it yet at
that point. One entry therefore means the same thing in every session, and the
model-facing note names the real path.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Profile config：A `workspace:` entry must be relative — `workspace:/etc` and `workspace:~/x` are
refused with a warning — and may not contain `..`, which is refused rather than
silently clamped so a configuration cannot escape the workspace. A directory
below the workspace that does not exist yet is still granted: the path is only
compared, and the bwrap profile skips a bind source that is missing.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Profile config：`writableDirs` only has an effect under a confined mode. A preset selecting
`danger-full-access` may list them — they stay visible in the table — but that
mode confines nothing, so they grant nothing extra and the model-facing note is
left untouched.

Preset order is configuration order, which is the order the picker offers them.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Settings page：`presets` is a volatile field, so the whole table also appears on the Settings
page and edits apply live to every session in the profile. The page edits it as
one document rather than as a nested form, so the profile patch above stays the
natural place to write it.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Compatibility with the harness：This plugin declares no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer range, and the harness checks
only such peers. Its compatibility therefore rests on something narrower and
more exact: **the shape of the mounted services it reads and wraps** (plus one
context name). That shape is what the code actually uses, and it is pinned by
`test/contract.test.js` against the real classes, so a harness upgrade that
moves any of it fails the suite immediately rather than narrowing a preset in
production.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Compatibility with the harness：| Depends on | Used by |
| --- | --- |
| `fs.checkedTarget(target, policy)` rejects with code `FS_SANDBOX_DENIED` | `src/fs.js` |
| `fs.resolve(path)` resolves a target carrying `targetKey` | `src/fs.js` |
| `sandbox.confine(argv, policy, signal)` resolves to an object carrying `argv` | `src/provider.js` |
| Policy fields `mode` and `sessionId`; result field `argv` | both wrappers |
| `permissionPresets.presets` and `emitCatalogChanged()` | `src/service.js` |
| `permissionPresets.permissionState(session)`, returning the recorded knobs | `src/service.js` |
| The prompt registry, and a `sandbox:policy` context to place the note beside | `src/service.js` |

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Compatibility with the harness：* The wrappers call the stock methods through `await`, so a stock method that
  changes between synchronous and asynchronous keeps working.
* Both wrappers operate on the returned object rather than assuming a bare argv,
  so a return value that grows fields keeps working.
* A session's selection is read from the service that owns it, not from the
  session projection store, where `stateOf(session, key)` is deprecated and warns
  once per key; `permissionState` is the same value the owner uses for its own
  `current`, and an activation that has not finished yet reads as no selection
  rather than as a failure.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Compatibility with the harness：When a mounted service does not expose the expected seam at all, the plugin
**reports it once per service** and leaves the instance untouched. It never
disables a stock row, so the failure mode of any unexpected harness shape is a
logged warning and stock behaviour — never a missing filesystem or sandbox.

Tested against harness `0.2.2-rc.1`. That release raises the minimum Node.js to
`24.9`, so this plugin declares the same floor in `engines`, and its CI matrix
starts there.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Platform support：* **Linux with `bwrap`** — fully supported. The configured directories join the
  bubblewrap profile as `--bind <dir> <dir>`, so confined commands agree with the
  write/edit tools.
* **Linux with `landlock`, and macOS `seatbelt`** — the write/edit tools are
  widened, but confined commands are not, because those profiles are built
  inside packages this plugin cannot extend. A warning is logged once instead of
  pretending otherwise.
* **Windows** — not supported.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Layout：| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `src/service.js` | `ctx.sandboxPresets`: owns the configured preset table, decides per session which preset applies, resolves `workspace:` entries against the calling session, wraps the two enforcement services, publishes the presets, and registers the model-facing note beside the stock sandbox note. |
| `src/presets.js` | Normalizes the configured table and expands each preset's directories. |
| `src/fs.js` | Wraps the live filesystem's containment check. |
| `src/provider.js` | Wraps the live sandbox provider's `confine`. |
| `src/roots.js` | Path expansion and containment checks. |
| `src/plan.js` | Pure bwrap argv transformation. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the one plugin row. |
| `test/contract.test.js` | Pins the harness seams this plugin extends. |

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Layout：The sources are plain JavaScript with JSDoc types, and `src/contracts.d.ts`
carries the structural shapes JSDoc states poorly. The package runs **from
source**: `main` and `exports` point at `src/`, so there is no build step and no
`lib/` — what you edit is exactly what the harness loads.

Note that the profile installs this package by **symlink** (`link:`), pointing at
this working tree, so an edit to `src/` is live for the profile immediately;
only the plugin must be reloaded.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Typecheck：```
pnpm run typecheck  # tsc -p tsconfig.json: checkJs over src/ and test/
```

The DSH packages are peer/dev dependencies only for their `.d.ts`; the runtime
imports nothing from them that the harness does not already provide.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Tests：```
pnpm test                        # node --test test/*.test.js
node scripts/require-no-skips.mjs # same run, failing on any skip
```

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · Tests：`src/roots.js`, `src/plan.js`, `src/presets.js`, and the two wrappers are
dependency-free and run anywhere. The contract and integration suites need the
DSH packages to be resolvable, so they run from an installed profile: the
contract suite pins the real stock seams, and the integration suite assembles the
real filesystem and sandbox provider and asserts both the widening and its exact
reversal on unload. Every suite that needs those packages skips with a reason
when they are absent, and never passes vacuously. Nothing to build first: the
suite runs against the same `src/` the harness loads.

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · dsh-sandbox-presets-extra：[English](README.md) | 简体中文

为 DeepSeek Harness 注册**任意数量的可配置权限预设**。每个预设自行选择一种沙箱模式与
一种审批策略，并声明在该模式原本允许的范围**之上**再额外可写的目录。

这覆盖了 harness 能表达的两种方向——`workspace-write` 预设打开会话工作区旁边的目录，
以及 `read-only` 预设只打开它列出的那些目录、此外一概不开——且每种都可以有任意多个。

三种自带沙箱模式未被改动：`read-only`、`workspace-write`、`danger-full-access`
的含义、持久化 schema 与升级阶梯全部保持原样。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 新增了什么：每个已配置的预设都会在权限选择器里占一项。一个典型配置：

| 预设 | 沙箱模式 | 审批 | 可写范围 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `read-only` | `read-only` | `ask` | 无 |
| `workspace-write` | `workspace-write` | `ask` | 工作区 + 临时目录 |
| `workspace-write-extra` | `workspace-write` | `ask` | 上述范围 **+ 它配置的目录** |
| `scratch` | `read-only` | `never` | **只有它配置的目录** |
| `danger-full-access` | `danger-full-access` | `never` | 全部 |

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 新增了什么：预设是**权限预设**，不是第四种 `SandboxMode`。这个区分正是关键：沙箱模式是一组封闭的
三值联合类型，会被写入 `sandbox/mode` 会话事件，并在会话恢复时由多个外部投影重新校验。
若在那里加入第四个值，**所有用过它的会话都将无法读取**。把已有的模式与额外行为打包在
一起，正是自带的 `auto` 预设采用的做法。

生效范围是**逐会话**的：仅当该会话最后记录的权限预设是某个预设时，该预设的目录才生效；
由于该选择存在于会话日志中，重启后依然保留。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 如何避免干扰：本插件不禁用、不替换、不重排任何自带行，而是**就地包装**两个正在运行的执行服务，
并在卸载时精确还原：

* 已挂载文件系统的包含性检查（`checkedTarget`）：当其拒绝发生时，针对当前预设授予的
  目录再重试一次；
* 沙箱 provider 的 `confine`：在 bwrap profile 中补上对应的 `--bind` 对。

fence 的重试**故意也覆盖 `read-only`**：自带 fence 在解析目标之前就直接拒绝 read-only
写入，因此包装会自行解析目标并与该预设的目录比较。这正是 `read-only` 预设也能授予写入
的原因，而它授予的恰好就是自己列出的那些目录。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 如何避免干扰：模型可见的那段说明也需要同样修正，因为自带的 `sandbox:policy` 说明只按 mode 生成：
`read-only` 下它声称什么都不可修改，`workspace-write` 下它只点名工作区，而选中的预设
实际上还可能让更多目录可写。因此本插件**注册一个属于自己的运行时 context**，紧跟在自带
说明之后，点名当前所选预设授予的目录。两种受限模式下自带说明读起来都是一条封闭边界，
因此这句话会把例外明白写出，而不是只靠「additionally」被理解为对上一句的覆盖：选中的
预设是 `read-only` 时，它写明这些目录**即使在前面的只读策略下**也可写（自带那句是一条
绝对禁令）；是 `workspace-write` 时，它写明这些目录**无论是否在 session workspace 内**
都可写（自带那句只点名工作区，读起来就是全部可写范围）。选中的预设是
`danger-full-access` 时，本插件什么都不注入：该模式本身不限制任何路径，说这些目录
「额外可写」会是假命题而非修正。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 如何避免干扰：注入采用自己的 context 而非改写自带那句，这一区别正是它能到达模型的原因。agent loop
在准备每次请求时会**从各自注册的 provider 重新解析每个运行时 context**，并把结果记录
成下一步读取的快照。因此，若本插件在 `system-prompt/assemble` 水波里改写别的子系统的
条目，这段文字会出现在直接调用 `assemble()` 的结果里，却**不会出现在任何真实步骤中**
——provider 自己的文本会把它替换掉。而属于本插件自己的 provider 能挺过这次刷新，并且
每次从当前选择重新渲染，因此那句说明会跟随预设切换。以自带的名字注册也不可行：
system-prompt 服务在同一层内以名字为键，重名会被拒绝。

由此产生两个性质，两者都很重要：

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 如何避免干扰：* **失败是安全的。** 若本插件未能加载，harness 仍保有原有的文件系统与沙箱，而不会
  失去它们。（另一条路——禁用自带行再插入替换行——没有这种回退：Cordis 拒绝为同一
  服务名注册两个提供者，因此也无法靠遮蔽来获得安全性。）
* **它是叠加式的。** 自带检查对它原本已处理的每种情况仍具权威性，只有它自身的拒绝
  才会被重新考虑。
dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 配置：两种方式都支持。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · profile 配置：```yaml
- id: sandbox-presets-extra
  name: dsh-sandbox-presets-extra
  config:
    presets:

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sandbox` | `workspace-write` | `read-only`、`workspace-write` 或 `danger-full-access` |
| `approval` | `ask` | `ask` 或 `never` |
| `writableDirs` | `[]` | 在所选模式之上额外可写的目录 |
| `name` | 预设键 | 可选显示标签 |
| `description` | 无 | 可选单行描述 |

除非确实想要特定标签，否则不要给 `name`：缺省时选择器按预设键推导文字
（`workspace-write-extra` 显示为 `Workspace Write Extra`），而一旦提供标签，它会
**原样显示为英文**——因为客户端只为自己的内置预设做本地化。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · profile 配置：目录必须是绝对路径；开头的 `~` 会被展开。符号链接会被解析，而**不存在或不是目录**的
条目会被**忽略并告警**，而不是被创建——授予一个没人指定的路径是危险的方向。展开是异步
的，因此某个目录只有在其自身展开成功之后才变为可写。若某个预设的 `sandbox` 或
`approval` 不是上述取值，它同样会被拒绝并告警，而不会被发布；保留名 `custom` 与
`auto` 也是如此。

以 `workspace:` 前缀开头的条目表示**相对于会话工作区**的路径，并按每个会话各自解析：

```yaml
workspace-write-extra:
  writableDirs:
    - /srv/shared-assets
    - workspace:notes        # <会话工作区>/notes

工作区下的目录在每次调用时解析，针对的是 harness 为调用会话折算出的根，而不是在插件加载
时解析一次：工作区属于会话，而插件在那一刻还不知道它。因此同一个条目在每个会话中含义
相同，模型可见的那段说明也会给出真实路径。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · profile 配置：`workspace:` 条目必须是相对路径——`workspace:/etc` 与 `workspace:~/x` 会被拒绝并告警
——且不得包含 `..`；包含 `..` 会被直接拒绝而非悄悄钳制，以免配置逃出工作区。工作区下
尚不存在的目录仍然会被授予：该路径只被用于比较，而 bwrap profile 会跳过缺失的 bind
源。

`writableDirs` 只在受限模式下起作用。选了 `danger-full-access` 的预设仍可列出它们
（它们也仍会出现在表里），但该模式本身不做任何限制，因此这些目录不会带来额外的可写
范围，模型可见的那段说明也保持原样。

预设顺序即配置顺序，也就是选择器展示它们的顺序。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 设置页：`presets` 是 volatile 字段，因此整张表也会出现在设置页，编辑后对该 profile 内的所有
会话实时生效。设置页把它当作一整份文档来编辑，而非嵌套表单，因此上面的 profile patch
仍是书写它的自然位置。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 与 harness 的兼容性：本插件不声明任何 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer 范围，而 harness 只检查这类 peer。
因此它的兼容性建立在更精确也更狭窄的东西上：**它所读取并包装的那些已挂载服务的形状**
（外加一个 context 名）。这个形状才是代码实际使用的东西，其中服务部分由
`test/contract.test.js` 对**真实类**加以固定——所以任何移动了它的 harness 升级都会
立刻让测试失败，而不是在生产环境里悄悄收窄某个预设。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 与 harness 的兼容性：| 依赖 | 使用处 |
| --- | --- |
| `fs.checkedTarget(target, policy)` 以错误码 `FS_SANDBOX_DENIED` 拒绝 | `src/fs.js` |
| `fs.resolve(path)` 解析出带 `targetKey` 的 target | `src/fs.js` |
| `sandbox.confine(argv, policy, signal)` 解析为带 `argv` 的对象 | `src/provider.js` |
| policy 的 `mode`、`sessionId` 字段；结果的 `argv` 字段 | 两个包装 |
| `permissionPresets.presets` 与 `emitCatalogChanged()` | `src/service.js` |
| `permissionPresets.permissionState(session)`，返回记录的旋钮值 | `src/service.js` |
| 提示词注册表，以及用于放置该说明、紧邻 `sandbox:policy` 的位置 | `src/service.js` |

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 与 harness 的兼容性：有若干性质让它在升级中保持稳健：

* 包装通过 `await` 调用自带方法，因此自带方法在同步与异步之间变化仍可工作。
* 两个包装都在**返回的对象**上操作，而不假设它是裸 argv，因此返回值新增字段仍可工作。
* 会话选中的预设从拥有它的服务读取，而非从 session projection store 读取——后者的
  `stateOf(session, key)` 已废弃且每个 key 告警一次；`permissionState` 与该服务自己
  `current` 所用的值相同，尚未完成的激活读作没有选择，而不是读作失败。

当某个已挂载服务完全不暴露预期的接缝时，插件会**每个服务告警一次**，并保持该实例
不变。它从不禁用自带行，因此任何意外 harness 形状下的失败模式都只是日志告警加自带
行为——绝不会变成文件系统或沙箱缺失。

已针对 harness `0.2.2-rc.1` 测试。该版本把最低 Node.js 提高到 `24.9`，因此本插件在
`engines` 中声明同一下限，CI 矩阵也从那里起步。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 平台支持：* **Linux + `bwrap`** —— 完全支持。配置的目录以 `--bind <dir> <dir>` 加入 bubblewrap
  profile，因此受限命令与 write/edit 文件工具的行为一致。
* **Linux + `landlock`，以及 macOS `seatbelt`** —— write/edit 文件工具会被放宽，
  但受限命令不会，因为那些 profile 构建在本插件无法扩展的包内部。此时会告警一次，
  而不是假装支持。
* **Windows** —— 不支持。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 文件结构：| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `src/service.js` | `ctx.sandboxPresets`：持有已配置的预设表、按会话判定哪个预设生效、把 `workspace:` 条目按调用会话解析、包装两个执行服务、发布预设，并在自带沙箱说明旁注册模型可见的那段说明。 |
| `src/presets.js` | 归一化配置的预设表，并展开每个预设的目录。 |
| `src/fs.js` | 包装运行中文件系统的包含性检查。 |
| `src/provider.js` | 包装运行中沙箱 provider 的 `confine`。 |
| `src/roots.js` | 路径展开与包含性判定。 |
| `src/plan.js` | 纯函数式的 bwrap argv 变换。 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入唯一的一行插件。 |
| `test/contract.test.js` | 固定本插件所扩展的 harness 接缝。 |

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 文件结构：源码就是带 JSDoc 类型的纯 JavaScript，JSDoc 不便表达的类型放在 `src/contracts.d.ts`。
本包**从源码直接运行**：`main` 与 `exports` 都指向 `src/`，没有构建步骤，也没有
`lib/`——你编辑的就是 harness 加载的内容。

注意 profile 以**符号链接**（`link:`）安装本包并指向当前工作树，因此改动 `src/` 对
profile 立即生效，只需重载插件。

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 类型检查：```
pnpm run typecheck  # tsc -p tsconfig.json：对 src/ 与 test/ 做 checkJs
```

dsh-sandbox-presets-extra README · 测试：```
pnpm test                        # node --test test/*.test.js
node scripts/require-no-skips.mjs # 同一批用例，遇到跳过即失败
```

`src/roots.js`、`src/plan.js`、`src/presets.js` 与两个包装都不依赖外部包，随处可运行。契约套件
与集成套件需要 DSH 包可被解析，因此需在已安装的 profile 中运行：契约套件固定真实的原生
接缝，集成套件则装配真实的文件系统与沙箱 provider，断言放宽生效以及卸载时的精确还原。
所有需要这些包的套件在包缺失时会带原因跳过，绝不空过。无需先行构建：套件直接针对
harness 加载的同一份 `src/` 运行。
